terrain.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for an original 2D tactical card game called Sylve, wide landscape 3:2. Primary request: a beautiful hand-painted fantasy forest battle arena, with an EMPTY broad flat rectangular stone playing field in the center, viewed from a gently elevated camera looking toward a distant forest village. Composition: the entire central 80% width and middle 65% height must be unobstructed, level, finely textured warm mossy stone paving with very low contrast so a game can overlay a 6-column by 4-row grid and character sprites. Symmetrical perspective, horizon in top 20%, ivy-covered low walls, ancient guardian statues at far upper corners, large trees framing left and right edges, turquoise forest mist, distant delicate stone towers, soft golden sunlight. Rich charming painterly 2D fantasy game illustration with crisp shapes and readable warm earthy colors, emerald and teal foliage, touches of amber. Terrain should feel welcoming and magical. Constraints: environment only, NO characters, NO creatures, NO cards, NO UI, NO grid lines, NO letters or text or logos or watermark. Clear central battlefield occupies most of the image, keep all tall scenery near edges and top.
